description: A polkit rule file grants lowpriv unconditional YES on all actions, allowing pkexec-based root execution without authentication.
detailed_description: /etc/polkit-1/rules.d/99-lowpriv-loose.rules unconditionally returns Result.YES for any action performed by user lowpriv. polkitd is running under systemd. Because pkexec is a SUID root binary that consults polkitd for authorization, lowpriv can execute arbitrary commands as root via pkexec.
